import html from typing import Final # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # will be replaced with the sanitized values passed to `format_post_content`. BLOG_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe display on a webpage. Args: post_title: The headline or title of the blog post. post_body: The full text content of the blog post. Returns: A string containing the sanitized, HTML‑formatted blog post. """ # Escape any HTML special characters in title and body to prevent XSS attacks safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Return the fully formatted post using the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
